title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about courses, training and career support.

faqs.question: What courses does Prime Webdynamics offer?
faqs.answer: Prime Webdynamics offers 8 job-oriented IT courses: Web Development, App Development, Digital Marketing, Python Programming, Frontend Technologies, Backend Technologies, Full Stack Developer and Data Analyst. Each course focuses on practical learning and industry-relevant skills.

faqs.question: Does Prime Webdynamics provide placement assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, Prime Webdynamics provides placement assistance after training. This includes ATS-friendly resume building, technical and HR mock interviews, aptitude preparation, GitHub and LinkedIn profile guidance, and support with job and internship opportunities.

faqs.question: Why should I choose Prime Webdynamics?
faqs.answer: Prime Webdynamics is an ISO 9001:2015 certified IT training institute focused on practical, industry-oriented learning. Students benefit from expert mentorship, real-world projects, small batches, doubt sessions, flexible timings and placement assistance.

faqs.question: Who can join Prime Webdynamics courses?
faqs.answer: Students from B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, M.Tech, B.Sc IT/CS, Diploma and Polytechnic backgrounds can join. 12th-pass students, graduates and working professionals can also explore suitable courses based on their interests and career goals.

faqs.question: Do you provide a certificate after course completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, students receive a course completion certificate after successfully completing the applicable course requirements and assessments.

faqs.question: Are practical projects included in the training?
faqs.answer: Yes, practical learning is an important part of the training. Students work on hands-on exercises, mini projects and major real-world projects to gain practical experience and build a portfolio for their careers.

faqs.question: Can beginners join Prime Webdynamics courses?
faqs.answer: Yes, several courses are suitable for beginners. Training follows a step-by-step approach, starting with basic concepts and progressing towards advanced topics through simple explanations, practical examples and hands-on practice.

faqs.question: What are the available batch timings and learning modes?
faqs.answer: Prime Webdynamics offers flexible morning, evening and weekend batches. Students can choose between offline classroom training and online learning, depending on the available options.

faqs.question: How can I enroll in a course?
faqs.answer: You can contact Prime Webdynamics for career counselling and course guidance. The team will help you understand your career goals, choose a suitable course and learn about the enrollment process.

faqs.question: Where is Prime Webdynamics located?
faqs.answer: Prime Webdynamics is located at Friends Tower, Opposite MAX Mall, Sanjay Palace, Agra. You can contact the institute at +91 79021 70568 for course-related enquiries.
